Thanks — happy to hop back on a 15-min intake if that helps.

Sergio — great to meet you. Quick responses below:

1) SOC 2 status: MedStream maintains an annual SOC 2 Type II for our core processing platform; we can share the most recent report with a Data Processing Agreement in place or via our secure trust portal.
2) Bridge letter: yes, we can provide a bridge letter/interim attestation for the current reporting period. We typically deliver that via the portal as a signed PDF.
3) Portal & procurement: I can provision a view-only account in our trust portal for redwood-inference@redwood.ai. Procurement (Karen) typically signs a short mutual NDA before full report access; however, we can share the bridge letter and a high-level summary without the NDA. If you prefer to receive the full Type II report, Karen will coordinate the procurement step.

Next steps from our side:
- I will send a portal invite link to the address you provided (expect within 24 hours).
- I attached our SOC overview and a template bridge letter to this reply for your review.
- Karen: looping you to advise on procurement timeline if Redwood will request the full report.

Also copying our security lead (security@medstream.com) — they can schedule an intake call if there are technical control questions.

Regards,
Alex Turner
Head of Partnerships | MedStream Health
alex.turner@medstream.com
